card.name: Spots just before blood-related medical terms
card.fires_on: Marks a position right before a blood or fluid-balance term such as hemoglobin, hyponatremia, hemodialysis or hyperkalemia. It fires on a space after a number, a word like "as", or a partial word.

modes.label: Space or number before a value
modes.description: A blank space after "than" or "p =" just before a number.

modes.label: Partway through a word
modes.description: A piece inside a long word such as hydroxocobalamin, hospital-acquired or hyperkalemia.
modes.example: due to the risk of hospital-ac<<quired>> hyponatremia. 5

modes.label: Linking word before a complication
modes.description: The word "as" in "such as" before a named neurologic complication.
modes.example: serious neurologic complications such<< as>> osmotic demyelination syndrome

card.writes: It lowers the odds of shock and hem- words coming next, which suggests it holds back those blood-related continuations.
card.plain: It lights up at small spots just before blood-related or sodium-related terms, and it steers the next word away from words like shock or hem-.
